DRAFT – requires salesperson approval – availability unconfirmed
Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Unfortunately, we can't meet the request as written, for two reasons:

- **Group size:** Our largest room is the Loft, which holds a maximum of 24 people. The Studio holds a maximum of 12. Neither fits 30 people.
- **Duration:** Our rooms are only available in 4-hour blocks. We have no 6-hour option and no price for one.

Because no package matches your request, I can't compare anything against your budget.

There is one alternative. It would only go ahead if you agree to the changes:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft + Lunch | 24 | €852 | duration shortened from 6 hours to the only available 4-hour block; headcount reduced from 30 to at most 24 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option is the Loft with lunch for up to 24 people, in a 4-hour block. You would give up the 6-hour duration, and you would have to reduce the group from 30 to at most 24. The Loft is wheelchair accessible. Lunch can be vegetarian or vegan on request. We cannot promise allergen-safe catering.

You asked us to confirm this today. I can't do that from this draft. Nothing is held for you, and availability for any date has to be checked separately. The listed prices are fixed.

If the alternative could work, please let me know your preferred date and how many people will attend. We can then check availability.

Kind regards
